business_problem: In the face of rising customer demand for new digital services, global telecommunications provider Vodafone is exploring innovative ways to enhance the customer experience, including better handling of complex inquiries and ensuring timely and personalized responses.
solution_summary: Vodafone used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Call-center telephony, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. "So, yes, we are also focused on expansion and serving more people and businesses, but that same strategy applies to our own employees too." solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for model orchestration, experimentation, and responsible AI operations.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Search
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and retrieves grounding context for assistants and search experiences.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies prebuilt AI capabilities such as language, speech, or vision services within the application flow.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Copilot
solution_components.role: Provides generative assistance inside end-user productivity workflows.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in Azure AI Search, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
